name: as-any
description: `as any` erases the type checker at that expression — on money and multi-tenant paths that's where a mispriced charge or a cross-org data leak hides. `(req as any)` and `(req.user as any).id`-style casts have typed replacements (AuthenticatedRequest + req.user.id, getOrganizationId(req)); Express-internals monkey-patches are the residual baseline. This ratchet freezes the count and drives it strictly DOWN — lower baselineCount whenever a reduction lands.
lastBumpNote: 1409 -> 1407 on 2026-08-09: developer-vertical Stage 1 extraction. Pulling the lot-pricing rule evaluation + premium-grid math out of server/routes-lot-pricing.ts into the pure, behaviourally-tested engine @shared/subdivision/lotPricing.ts typed away the two `(rules.rules as any)` casts at the preview/lock call sites — the drizzle-inferred lot_pricing_rules.rules type matches the engine's LotPricingRule[] param, so no cast is needed. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 1419 -> 1417 on 2026-08-01: reduction earned by the founder-authorized deletion wave (voice + satellite/vision subsystems, five SCP modules, unreached ML registry) — the deleted files carried these occurrences. Locked in the same commit per ratchet rule. PRIOR NOTE — 1428 -> 1425 on 2026-07-30: stale-high baseline locked in — a REDUCTION, not a bump. Wave D's rental half added zero new casts (the rent-ledger unit-count read narrows drizzle's driver-dependent execute() result with `as unknown as <shape>` rather than erasing the type, and the new server/services/rental/* modules are fully typed against the Drizzle row types); the three that disappeared came out of the same wave's rewrites of the surfaces it touched. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule — a stale-high baseline is free headroom for the next untyped money hop, which is exactly what this gate exists to deny. PRIOR NOTE — 1429 -> 1428 on 2026-07-29: platform money-custody purge (founder ruling "be the rail, not the provider"). marketplace.completeTransaction() carried `.set({ stripePaymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id } as any)` against a column that does not exist on marketplace_transactions, inside a swallowing catch — so Drizzle would have thrown and the id was NEVER persisted while the code read as if it were. The cast was the only thing hiding it. Replaced with an honest structured log line (the Stripe side already carries metadata.transactionId); the frozen marketplace module does not get a new column for it. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 1433 -> 1429 on 2026-07-29: Wave B ('Wire the engine') cleanup. The wave's 7 new casts were TYPED rather than baselined — leads.deletedAt/organizationId read straight off the Lead row (organizationId is notNull, so the old `as number | undefined` was actively lying about a multi-tenant key), the CSV-import drizzle insert and the workflow_delay_resume claim-update payloads type-check as-is, isWithinQuietHoursForLead accepts a Lead unchanged, and the two contactFrequency boundaries were narrowed to precise shapes (`Record<string, unknown>` for the organizations.settings jsonb blob; `Date | string | null` for the driver-dependent timestamp) per the routes-rent-ledger.ts precedent. Fixing the underlying types also cleared 3 pre-existing casts of the same shape in sequenceProcessor.ts. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule.
